REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - AUGUST 13, 2015 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
AUGUST 13, 2015 IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Chaplain Norman Griffith, NASCAR Motor Racing.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Cerritos Youth Soccer Division Rookie 2 Team,
  “The Minions.”

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair George Ray
  Mayor/Chair Carol Chen

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Norma Williamson spoke regarding Neighborhood Watch in Cerritos and submitted
  two (2) documents for the record entitled, “Petition to City of Cerritos Mayor & Council
  Members To Install One Official Neighborhood sign On Street Corner Lamp Post” and
  “Please join us on Nextdoor Cerritos.”

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
  motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency
  Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated August 13, 2015
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated August 13, 2015 in the total amount of
  $6,317,263.44 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  August 13, 2015

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of
  July 16, 2015 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of July 16, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  July 23, 2015 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of July 23, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Approval of the Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending June 30, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending June 30, 2015 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 9.48, USE OF PARKS AND
  RECREATION AREAS, OF TITLE 9 PUBLIC PEACE, SAFETY AND MORALS OF THE CITY
  OF CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE BY AMENDING SECTION 9.48.020(F) AND ADDING
  SECTION 9.48.080 TO ESTABLISH RULES OF CONDUCT FOR UPHOLDING THE SAFE,
  PEACEFUL, AND PRODUCTIVE ENVIRONMENT WITHIN THE CERRITOS LIBRARY
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian and Marketing Manager.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments and the public
  hearing.
 City of Cerritos  August 13, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Direct the City Manager and/or his designee to implement the Rules of Conduct for
  Cerritos Library Patrons Levels of Violations and Penalties; and
  2. Waive reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 996, introduce AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 9.48, USE OF PARKS AND
  RECREATION AREAS, OF TITLE 9 PUBLIC PEACE, SAFETY AND MORALS
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE BY AMENDING SECTION
  9.48.020(F) AND ADDING SECTION 9.48.080 TO ESTABLISH RULES OF
  CONDUCT FOR UPHOLDING THE SAFE, PEACEFUL, AND PRODUCTIVE
  ENVIRONMENT WITHIN THE CERRITOS LIBRARY (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of approval for the expenditure of funds for the
  replacement, removal, and repairs of two 24-inch butterfly valves located on 166th
  Street in the City of Cerritos and City of Artesia (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vince Brar, Senior Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Make a finding that staff has negotiated a fair and reasonable cost for the
  installation of the 24-inch butterfly valve located at 166th Street and Maidstone
  Avenue in the City of Artesia; and
  2. Make a finding that staff has negotiated a fair and reasonable cost for the removal of
  the 24-inch butterfly valve and repace with a spool at 166th Street and Girdley Road
  in the City of Cerritos; and
  3. Approve the expenditure of funds in the amount of $110,117.00 for the installation
  of a 24-inch butterfly valve at 166th Street and Maidstone Avenue in the City of
  Artesia and the replacement of a 24-inch butterfly valve with a spool in the City of
  Cerritos to Doty Bros. Equipment Company (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  August 13, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration of an amendment to the agreement between the City of
  Cerritos and Dapeer, Rosenblit and Litvak, LLP to extend the agreement for legal
  services to assist with code enforcement and community development activity to June
  30, 2016 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Daryl Evans, Public Safety Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Approve the amendment to the agreement between the City of Cerritos and
  Dapeer, Rosenblit and Litvak, LLP to extend the agreement for legal services to
  assist with code enforcement and community development activities to June 30,
  2016; and
  2. Authorize City staff to go out to bid for legal services to assist with code
  enforcement and community development activities when the term of this contract
  amendment has concluded (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  None.

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards, Pulido, and Solanki, Mayor
